requiredInfrastructure: dedicated Panels deployment and publisher
anonymous and OIDC audience identities
sealed collection recipient
suites.cleanup: Use only the collection-enabled synthetic deployment, erase every anonymous and authenticated session, fsync sealed collection custody before acknowledgement, and retain only bounded synthetic audit metadata.

requiredInfrastructure: dedicated Panels deployment with an external tool in its authored package
synthetic audience identity
runtime control identity
suites.cleanup: Use only a dedicated synthetic deployment and session, answer one deterministic external call through the public edge, prove a second answer cannot replace the first, then erase the synthetic session and retain only bounded audit evidence.

requiredInfrastructure: dedicated managed placement
bounded model gateway identity
disposable package, instance and fork
suites.cleanup: Reuse one stable synthetic placement and deterministic instance, turn, and fork identities; checkpoint its clean baseline before mutation, close every stream, restore the baseline, remove synced files, and retain only bounded synthetic runtime projections.

requiredInfrastructure: dedicated tenant placement
runtime control credential
deployed Durable workflow origin
suites.cleanup: Forward bounded GET and POST probes through the stable synthetic placement, prove missing-token denial, then rely on the shared managed-host checkpoint restore and file cleanup; no nonexistent placement deletion route is assumed.

requiredInfrastructure: dedicated private Home and tenant
ephemeral P-256 execution grant
disposable command and package
suites.cleanup: Use one stable command-scoped Durable object and deterministic package, issue a fresh five-minute request-bound grant on every call, perform no model effect or spend, and retain only the bounded synthetic policy, instance, and position projections.

requiredInfrastructure: Dedicated synthetic placement and signed policy bound only to the model authority's bounded synthetic OpenAI provider with its Raw context delayed-body marker
Harness Worker with pinned governance root and authenticated model-broker transport resolving only a fresh synthetic canary credential
Runtime control credential and a separate public-session credential for denial checks
suites.cleanup: Cancel the synthetic model call, verify the transient request body is no longer readable, restore the placement baseline, and remove synced files. The synthetic provider releases a held body after twenty seconds even when cancellation is interrupted.

requiredInfrastructure: Dedicated synthetic norm ledger placement with deployment-owned principal bindings, creation grant and a restoration checkpoint for that object in the Worker's norm trust (DR-0140)
One stable act of that ledger, signed by the synthetic signer outside the runner and presented verbatim as an exact retry; the runner holds no signing key
suites.cleanup: Reuse only the dedicated synthetic ledger and its one stable signed act, so every run after the first is an exact retry that adds nothing. Norm evidence is append-only: never erase production history or restore an older authority checkpoint as cleanup, and the runner calls no delete, discard, restore or rollback route. The runner fails once the synthetic history exceeds 256 events.

requiredInfrastructure: Disposable synthetic Agent, exact authoring target, and pinned Main cut owned by a dedicated Home
Terminal Home ledger receipt and separate Agent-authoring execution grant with private retirement authorization
Dedicated command-scoped private object store and isolated synthetic provider capability
suites.cleanup: Run only the disposable synthetic Agent-authoring command, wait for its terminal Home receipt, and retry command-scoped object retirement until its keys are absent. Preserve the Agent Main cut and never infer a project identity or remove another command's objects.

requiredInfrastructure: Dedicated synthetic private Home and tenant with a signer admitted by the deployed private Worker
Production R2 bucket with command-scoped objects and one disposable nonsecret command per UTC day
Synthetic terminal-only signed execution grant with a distinct retirement authorization bit
suites.cleanup: Use only nonsecret daily synthetic bytes, retire the day's command in the same journey, and assert collection and the permanent fence. Later passes that day retry the same receipt without placing bytes. The runtime retains one small tombstone per UTC day; the synthetic R2 copy must be absent after each fresh pass.

requiredInfrastructure: A Home able to supply its hosted execution peer with candidate cuts (DR-0139, flowing-branch tracker FB-6); no production route puts a cut into a hosted object until then
Deployment-owned planning roles, the verified executor image pinned by digest with its runtime and image binding, the executor token, and a container pool above zero (DR-0140's evidence half)
Synthetic running instance with installed observer capability and requirement record, for authenticated enqueue and retry
Synthetic settled norm execution with retained runtime journal and an observation publication signed externally once at provisioning; the journey only republishes what the host retains
Synthetic line the peer holds, promoted once under a stable promotion identity, with a synthetic reservation grant
suites.cleanup: The journey is written and tested (runNormEvidence) but not dispatched. When it runs it reuses only the dedicated synthetic ledger and stable signed invocation identities, so every run after the first is an exact retry; norm evidence is append-only, and it calls no delete, discard, restore or rollback route. A promotion moves only a line the peer holds, never a Home's trunk.
